title: Get 20TB of cloud storage for life for less than a year of iCloud
content_html:
TL;DR: Lock in 20TB of cloud storage for just $349.95 with this Scramble Cloud Storage lifetime subscription, on sale now for only $349.95 (MSRP $1,440).

Credit: Scramble Cloud

$349.95
$1,440 Save $1,090.05

Since we all have cameras within reach at all times, our digital lives continue to grow as we capture photos and videos. The only problem? All of that data has to go somewhere — and you’re probably paying for it with monthly cloud storage fees.

If you’re looking for somewhere a little more permanent to keep your content, it’s time to meet Scramble Cloud Storage. Right now, you can lock in an impressive 20TB of cloud storage for life for just $349.95.

How much are you paying to store your files? If you’re with iCloud, you’re endlessly forking over $360 a year for 6TB of space. A Scramble Cloud Storage lifetime subscription lets you pay less than that once, while securing more than triple that amount of space.

Scramble Cloud Storage doesn’t just offer highly competitive pricing for a large amount of cloud storage space. It also offers peace of mind with secure file-sharing capabilities that ensure your content is encrypted using the Advanced Encryption Standard and a zero-knowledge architecture that gives you total control over who gets access to it.

You don’t have to worry about a learning curve — Scramble Cloud Storage has a simple drag-and-drop interface and a familiar folder layout. You can also preview files instantly, share links, stream videos, or view Word and Excel files right in your browser. And it works via a desktop client, WebDAV, CLI, or web app.

This lifetime subscription gives you 20 TB of storage, unlimited file sharing, and bandwidth. You’ll also have access to ongoing platform updates.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Secure this Scramble Cloud Storage lifetime subscription for only $349.95 today.
